hypotheses.explanation: The checkout-to-payment client span takes 94.4 ms, while the payment server span and service-side duration metric are under 1 ms; this edge contributes substantially to the slow PlaceOrder call.
A checkout-to-currency client span lasts 90.8 ms although the currency server span is 0.322 ms; the checkout-side Convert metric also reports elevated latency.
Several frontend server spans end with ERROR across distinct routes, while their downstream service spans complete successfully, pointing to errors at the frontend layer.
